input.content:
import mteb
import numpy as np

with open("/app/data.txt", "r") as f:
    docs = [line.rstrip("\n") for line in f if line.strip()]

model = mteb.get_model(
    "BAAI/bge-small-zh-v1.5",
    revision="7999e1d3359715c523056ef9478215996d62a620",
)

query = "terminal-bench"
q_emb = model.encode([query])
d_emb = model.encode(docs)

q = np.asarray(q_emb)
d = np.asarray(d_emb)

q_norm = q / np.linalg.norm(q, axis=1, keepdims=True)
d_norm = d / np.linalg.norm(d, axis=1, keepdims=True)

sims = (d_norm @ q_norm.T).flatten()

order = np.argsort(-sims)
print("Top 10:")
for i, idx in enumerate(order[:10]):
    print(f"{i+1}. sim={sims[idx]:.4f} | {docs[idx]}")

fifth = docs[order[4]]
with open("/app/result.txt", "w") as f:
    f.write(fifth)
print("\nWrote:", fifth)
